statement: Suppose c0 ∈ int K. Then the following statements hold: 1. K is a rational polyhedral cone. 2. Every facet has a primitive nonnegative support form η ∈ Λ∗ satisfying η(c0) = 1. 3. The semigroup and its interior lattice points satisfy Γ = K ∩ Λ, int K ∩ Λ = c0 + Γ. (5.12) 34 In particular, Γ is a finitely generated saturated affine semigroup with group Λ. These conclusions apply to every sufficiently far grading and chosen point covered by Theorem 4.8, including its exact rational case.
